**Headline**

Applicants for the 2026 Etinosa Oghogho Foundation Academic Scholarship should check their email for updates, as the foundation's published timeline places finalist notifications and planned disbursements within September and October.



**About**

The scholarship provides need-based educational support to students enrolled in Nigerian federal and state universities, with the aim of helping students from financially disadvantaged backgrounds continue their education.



**What are the benefits?**

The scholarship offers a one-time financial award to selected students. For beneficiaries, this support can help ease some of the financial demands of university education and make it easier to concentrate on academic work.



**What should applicants do next?**

Students who receive an update should read it carefully and follow any instructions concerning interviews, document verification or award acceptance. Keep your admission letter, student ID, birth certificate and document showing your CGPA available, as these are among the supporting documents listed by the foundation.



If you have not received a message, continue monitoring your email while awaiting further communication.



For  timely notifications about scholarship awards and opportunities, follow our WhatsApp channel via: https://whatsapp.com/channel/0029VbBZ42aBlHpZfJ6KWv0I

**Headline:**

Successful applicants for the FATE Scholar Programme have been contacted. Applicants who participated in the selection process should check their email for updates and any further instructions.



**About** 

The FATE Scholar Programme supports young Nigerians pursuing higher education, combining financial assistance with opportunities for mentorship and professional development.



**Benefits of the Programme**

Beyond financial support for education, scholars can benefit from mentorship, career guidance and internship opportunities that help them prepare for life after university. These opportunities can provide valuable exposure to the workplace and help students build professional networks while completing their studies.



**What happens next?**

Successful applicants should read their notification carefully and respond to any requests within the stated deadline. Keep your admission documents and other academic records ready for verification, and pay attention to instructions concerning acceptance of the award, scholarship conditions and subsequent activities.



For those who have not received an update, check your inbox and spam folder regularly.

Five Successful applicants have been notified of their scholarship award via mail.

**About**

The NIPES–Comfort Architectural Finishing Limited Scholarship offers financial support to undergraduates studying architecture and related fields. Applicants following the 2026 selection process should check their email and official NIPES communications for updates concerning their applications.

posts.body:
**Headline**

Successful applicants for the UCEF Scholarship have been contacted for the interview stage. 3 of our members have  been selected.  If you applied, check the email you used during the application process for updates on your application.

**More details:**

As of October 14th, 2026, applicants who have made it pass the Questionnaire stage of the UCEF scholarship have been contacted via mails notifying them of progression to the interview stage, after which the final successful candidates will be selected.

**About** 

The UCEF Scholarship supports eligible Christian students pursuing undergraduate studies at federal and state universities in South-East and South-South Nigeria.

**Benefits of the UCEF Scholarship**

The programme provides the following financial support to awardees:

1. Tuition fees of over ₦150,000 paid directly to the school 
2. Reimbursement of accommodation, loans, and other expenses amounting to about ₦150,000 

**What should successful applicants do next?**

If you have received a notification, read the message carefully and follow the instructions provided. Successful applicants should also prepare their academic records and any documents requested for the interview stage. 

Applicants should monitor their email for additional instructions from UCEF.

Congratulations to the applicants who have progressed to the interview stage.  

If you didn't get selected, please don't be discouraged, avail yourself with several other scholarships available on our platform.



For  timely notifications about scholarship awards and opportunities, follow our WhatsApp channel via: https://whatsapp.com/channel/0029VbBZ42aBlHpZfJ6KWv0I
